question_template.instructions: Post {pid} in STATE.posts: is the term '{term}' used there in its slang sense (the recorded slang meaning in STATE, or a close slang variant/extension of it), or is it an unrelated same-spelling use (a name, school, team, company, product, ticker/token symbol, technical or scientific term, the literal ordinary word, part of another word, or another language)? Also answer use_mention: MENTION if the post draws attention to the word itself (defines, quotes, asks what it means, comments on its form) rather than using it to convey meaning; otherwise USE. A definition embedded inside a genuine use is USE. A MENTION is never SLANG_SENSE: label its sense OTHER_SENSE. Judge only post {pid}.

criteria.SLANG_SENSE: uses the term in its slang sense (USE only)
criteria.OTHER_SENSE: unrelated same-spelling use (name, school, company, ticker, technical term, literal ordinary word, other language), not the slang sense; also any MENTION of the term

criteria_use_mention.USE: the term conveys meaning in the post
criteria_use_mention.MENTION: the post is about the word itself (definition, quotation, question, form)

related: rebuilt-sense-anchored-v1: same question, but for terms with an operator definition the definition is passed as the anchor sense and a slang sense not in the definition counts as OTHER_SENSE (labels keyed by definition sha256).
